citations.assessment: The checked Bavli gives Abaye blessing at the light of Bar Avuha’s house. Heilprin reads Bar Chavu. The link identifies the cited passage and the note preserves the discrepancy.
Abaye says tefillin are readily available at Bar Chavu’s house.
Abaye’s permission in the Bavli explicitly includes both tefillin and mezuzot. Heilprin quotes only tefillin.
The separate entry cites a person of this name before Rav Ashi. Heilprin lists him separately here.
The external comparison confirms Adda bar Chavu as the speaker before Rav Ashi and does not identify him with the scribe.
